annotations.title: List open viewing slots for a property on a date

description: List pre-scheduled viewing appointment slots that are still open for a property on a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to tomorrow, UK time). Many listings have no pre-scheduled slots at all — an empty list does NOT mean viewings are impossible: book_viewing with preferred days/times works for every listing and the agent will propose a time.

date.description: Date to check, YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to tomorrow, UK time)
